name: Google Workspace
description: Google Workspace APIs through the official Google Workspace CLI (gws): Drive, Sheets, Docs, Slides, Gmail, Calendar, Tasks, People, Chat, Forms, Meet and more. A few generic tools run any gws command, describe API methods and show help; files are exchanged through /work. Authenticates with an OAuth access token from WorkMux, an access token secret or a service account key.
instructions:
Google Workspace through the gws CLI: Drive, Sheets, Docs, Slides, Gmail, Calendar, Tasks, People, Chat, Forms, Meet, Keep, Classroom and Apps Script. Four tools: run, schema, help, auth_status.

1. Check access: auth_status says which Google identity is used. With a service account, share the Drive files, folders or calendars with its e-mail first; it has no Gmail mailbox. With no credentials, tell the owner to set them in WorkMux (the plugin explains how).
2. Find the method: help [] lists services; help ["drive"] lists resources and + helpers; help ["drive","files"] lists methods; help ["gmail","+send"] shows a helper's flags. Commands mirror the REST API: gws <service> <resource> [sub-resource] <method>.
3. Read its parameters: schema {"method":"drive.files.list"}. Query/path parameters go to --params as one JSON string, the request body to --json.
4. Call run with args as an array of strings (no shell, no quoting). Examples:
   - Drive list: ["drive","files","list","--params","{\"pageSize\":20,\"q\":\"trashed=false\",\"fields\":\"files(id,name,mimeType,modifiedTime)\"}"]
   - Drive download: ["drive","files","get","--params","{\"fileId\":\"ID\",\"alt\":\"media\"}","--output","/work/report.pdf"] (Google Docs: drive files export with mimeType)
   - Drive upload: ["drive","+upload","/work/report.pdf","--name","Report"]
   - Sheets read: ["sheets","+read","--spreadsheet","ID","--range","Sheet1!A1:D20"]
   - Sheets append: ["sheets","+append","--spreadsheet","ID","--values","Alice,95"]
   - Docs get: ["docs","documents","get","--params","{\"documentId\":\"ID\"}"]
   - Calendar events: ["calendar","+agenda"] or ["calendar","events","list","--params","{\"calendarId\":\"primary\",\"timeMin\":\"2026-01-01T00:00:00Z\",\"singleEvents\":true,\"orderBy\":\"startTime\",\"maxResults\":20}"]
   - Gmail list: ["gmail","users","messages","list","--params","{\"userId\":\"me\",\"q\":\"is:unread\",\"maxResults\":10}"] or ["gmail","+triage"]
   - Gmail send: ["gmail","+send","--to","a@example.com","--subject","Hi","--body","Text","--attach","/work/file.pdf"]
   Add --dry-run to see the request without sending it. Ask the user before sending mail, deleting or sharing.
5. Files: every file path (--upload, --output, --output-dir, --attach, drive +upload, script +push --dir) must be in /work. Bring user files in with plugin_upload_file, hand results over with plugin_download_file. Output over 64 KB is saved to /work and its path returned; narrow requests with fields, pageSize or --page-limit.

gws auth login/setup/export/logout are disabled: credentials come from WorkMux. gmail +watch and events +subscribe need --once. The container and /work are deleted after the conversation is idle.

secrets.description: Service account key JSON (the whole file). The plugin then acts as the service account: share files and calendars with its e-mail.
OAuth2 access token for Google APIs (expires after about an hour; an OAuth connection is better).

oauth.description: Google account the plugin acts as (OAuth connection of the project shared with the bot).

accepts.description: File to upload to Drive or attach to an e-mail (any type works)
Data to upload or import into Sheets

returns.description: Large JSON/NDJSON command output saved instead of returned inline
